title: A Colony for the Static Again
author: Lena Fairweather
blurb: Lior Almeida, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
